name: Tag
purpose: A status label. Rule from source: text = colour shade-50, background = colour tint-80 — the pairing is generated, guaranteeing ~9:1.

accessibility.notes: colour is never the only carrier; the tag text is the status

antiPatterns: free-picking tag colours instead of the shade-50/tint-80 derivation
making tags clickable without becoming a real control

provenance.$finding: F5 — no figma_node: the engine's hub identity is Figma-shaped; code-source systems need a package+path hub
